context.goal: Extend non-convergence recovery hardening beyond BJT to other nonlinear elements

symptoms: Convergence failures or numerical blow-ups can be driven by PN junction models (diodes/LED arrays/body diodes) and tunnel diodes
Some elements hard-stopped on 'max current exceeded', disrupting the 'never stop' goal
root_cause: Exponential device models can overflow or produce extreme conductances/currents during stiff operating points
Hard-stop guards in some element stepFinished() paths prevented solver recovery from taking over

changes.summary: Make diode limiting panic-aware, honor simulator extra gmin, ramp gmin earlier in panic mode, and clamp exp arguments to avoid overflow
Relax limiter in panic mode, add extra gmin, clamp exponentials, and avoid stamping NaN/Inf
Relax per-iteration voltage limiting in panic mode and use simulator extra gmin as a floor for the small Gds stabilizer
Replace hard stop on huge/NaN diode current with clamp + converged=false
Replace hard stop on huge/NaN LED currents with clamp + converged=false
Replace hard stop on huge/NaN segment current with clamp + converged=false
Clamp exp arguments to avoid overflow/NaN after limiter relaxation

tradeoffs: In panic mode the diode limiter is intentionally more permissive and gmin can be much larger
Clamping exp inputs preserves finiteness but can hide extreme-physics behavior
